# Review Checklist: Trainer builds, edits and publishes a plan

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements: are the domain rules, API refusals, ownership and editor UX written completely and clearly enough to build and review against?
**Created**: 2026-11-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Domain rules

- [x] CHK001 Is each limit of a plan stated with both its lower and upper bound? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK002 Is the split between rules for every plan and rules for a complete plan unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK003 Is "day of the week" used consistently, with no remaining use of "weekday" that could be read as Monday to Friday? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK004 Is the moment each rule level applies specified for all three transitions: first save, draft save, published save? [Coverage, Data model §State transitions]
- [x] CHK005 Are the semantics of an empty load distinguished from a load of 0? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK006 Is what "current plan week" means defined for a plan past its last week? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007, User Story 4]
- [x] CHK007 Is the meaning of "applies from today" stated in terms a test can check, given that sessions and logs do not exist yet? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012, Assumptions]

## API refusals and ownership

- [x] CHK008 Does every refusal have a stable code and a status? [Completeness, Data model §Rule codes, Contract]
- [x] CHK009 Are the codes for a foreign client and an own client with no plan specified so that nothing about foreign clients leaks? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK010 Are the roles and sign-in states refused specified for all three operations? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK011 Is the refusal for an exercise of another trainer specified so that it does not reveal whether the exercise exists? [Clarity, Spec User Story 6]
- [x] CHK012 Are requirements defined for a stale save and for two simultaneous first saves? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Is a stale publish covered as well as a stale save? [Consistency, Contract]
- [x] CHK014 Is the exercise library's plan count specified so that it reveals nothing about other trainers? [Coverage, Spec §FR-033, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK015 Are size limits on a saved plan stated, so a request stays bounded? [Non-functional, Spec §FR-005]

## Editor UX

- [x] CHK016 Are the loading, error and empty states of the Plan tab all specified, including a client without a quiz? [Completeness, Spec User Story 1, §FR-031]
- [x] CHK017 Is the behaviour of publishing with unsaved changes specified for a failure between the save and the publish? [Exception Flow, Spec User Story 3]
- [x] CHK018 Are the actions offered specified for each plan state, including a new plan not yet saved? [Coverage, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK019 Is it clear when a field's error appears: on leaving the field, on Save, or both? [Clarity, Spec User Story 2]
- [x] CHK020 Is the validation summary's content specified: what each line names and where its link goes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements for every way of leaving specified: tabs, sidebar, browser back, reload, close, sign out? [Coverage, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK022 Is the assumed work time of the estimated time specified enough to test? [Measurability, Spec §FR-024, Research R15]
- [x] CHK023 Is every departure from the board stated with its reason, so that a reviewer can overturn it? [Traceability, Spec §Departures]
- [x] CHK024 Are the exact English and Polish texts defined, or is it stated who decides them? [Gap]

## Accessibility

- [x] CHK025 Are focus requirements stated for each confirmation: where it starts and where it returns? [Completeness, Spec User Stories 2, 3, 5]
- [x] CHK026 Is a non-dragging way of reordering specified, with what happens to focus at the first and last place? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022, Research R11]
- [x] CHK027 Are accessible names specified for per-row fields and controls? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK028 Is the marker on a session with problems specified as more than colour? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK029 Is the expected behaviour at 375 px stated, given a phone layout for trainers is out of scope? [Clarity, Spec §FR-035, Assumptions]

## Dependencies and assumptions

- [x] CHK030 Is the dependency on #94 for "a session already started keeps its targets" written where #94's owner will see it? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK031 Is the interaction with #84 (a draft arriving while the trainer builds a plan) stated? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK032 Is the interaction with #53's routing, now that `PLAN_PUBLISHED` can be answered, documented? [Dependency, Spec §FR-017]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- `/speckit-implement` reads this checklist's state but does not change its markers
- 2026-11-01: evaluated by the agent at the reviewer's request, after the spec was changed to resolve the gaps. CHK030 closed by a comment on issue #94, with one on #84 for CHK031, both posted with the reviewer's approval.
